name: 1-foreign-fs: another file system on the data partition is refused
1-foreign-fs: the data partition is unchanged
2-foreign-luks: a LUKS2 volume with another UUID on the data partition is refused
2-foreign-luks: the data partition is unchanged
3-not-empty: unknown bytes after the first 16 MiB on the data partition is refused
3-not-empty: the data partition is unchanged
4-interrupted-setup: an unfinished setup is done again: TPM C unlocks and mounts it
4-interrupted-setup: LUKS2 header has the TPM token as its only keyslot (read on the build host)
5-first-boot-no-tpm: without a TPM the partition is not encrypted, not mounted, the agent stays off
5-first-boot-no-tpm: the data partition is still all zeros
6-first-boot-tpm-a: TPM A encrypts, unlocks and mounts the partition on a slow disk; the agent starts
6-first-boot-tpm-a: the setup finished after systemd's default device timeout would have expired
6-first-boot-tpm-a: LUKS2 header has the TPM token as its only keyslot (read on the build host)
6-first-boot-tpm-a: what the agent's directory holds never appears in the disk's raw bytes
7-tpm-a-again: TPM A unlocks it again, without formatting; the data is still there
8-other-tpm: another TPM cannot unlock it: no prompt, not mounted, the agent stays off
9-tpm-removed: without the TPM it stays locked: no prompt, not mounted, the agent stays off
10-tpm-a-cleared: TPM A after TPM2_Clear cannot unlock it: no prompt, not mounted, the agent stays off
11-tpm-a-last: the failed unlocks destroyed nothing: TPM A opens the same volume with the same data
11-tpm-a-last: the LUKS2 header is the one the first boot wrote
11-tpm-a-last: the marker still never appears in the disk's raw bytes
12-duplicate-uuid: another disk with the volume's UUID: the setup refuses, the volume stays locked
12-duplicate-uuid: neither disk changed
